__NOTOC__ Unforgiving Sentinels were night elf Sentinels located in Mist's Edge in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns. They were locked in combat with Sin'dorei Vanguards on the beach and ships.

Unlocking the Heart's Potential was available when you reached reputation with the Champions of Azeroth prior to patch 8.2.0. Note that you would NOT get any hint or introduction that you've unlocked it.
Unidentified Hands are looted from Disturbed Mud in the Broken Shore and Demonwaste Piles in Suramar.
Unicorn mounts are equine mounts first introduced in Wrath of the Lich King.
__NOTOC__ Unhinged Cravens are Zandalari dire trolls located in Nazmir. They are being corrupted by Corrupted Vessels.
Unleashed Azerite are Azerite elementals located in Blackrock Depths during Blackrock Depths (quest).
Unliving Battlebeast is Ren'Zuli's skeletal devilsaur mount located in Nazmir.
Unleashed Tidebreaker is an unbound water elemental being channeled by Tidesage Summoners in Stormsong Monastery in Boralus.
Unleashed Currents are water elementals located at the Spears of Azshara in Nazjatar.
University may refer to: *Gearshaft University of gnomes *Stormwind University of the RPG *Income Optimization University of goblins *University of Suramar

Unidentified Mass can be bought from Flrgrrl in Mezzamere and Newhome in Nazjatar for .
Unliving Augurs are skeletal trolls located in the Battle of Dazar'alor.

Unliving Guardians are draenei ghosts of Slain Sha'tar Vindicators found at Auchindoun in Terokkar Forest. Auchenai Doomsayers send their spirits to nearby devices, managed by Auchenai Death-Speakers, reanimating their ghosts who then head further into Auchindoun. There, they are absorbed into a coffin, in a ritual overseen by additional Auchenai Death-Speakers.
Unending Voidwraiths are voidwraiths located in the tubes of Manaforge Ultris in the Netherstorm.
__NOTOC__ Unleashed Arcanofiend is an arcane elemental located in Nazjatar.
Ungormath is a fire elemental summoned in Mardivas's Laboratory in Nazjatar.
Unleashed Nightmares are flesh beasts located in Eternal Palace.
Unearthed Paragon is a mantid located in the middle of the Five Sisters in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Universal Remote is provided as an objective for Universal Remote-Explode.
Unfinished Irontide Cannons are cannons located in Tiragarde Sound.
Undying Soldiers are Maldraxxi skeletons located at the Temple of Courage in Bastion.
Unerring Vision is an Azerite trait available to Marksmanship hunters.
Unfathomable is a quest achievement earned by completing the Nazjatar storylines.
__NOTOC__ The Unleashed Major Hex is a mana surge located in the Grove of Memory in Ardenweald.
The Unfinished Blade is a part of the Blade of the Primus looted from inside the Standing Rock in Maldraxxus.
Unearthed Keepers are four titan watchers located in eastern Uldum during Assault: Amathet Advance.
Unleashed Familiars are arcane elementals summoned by Grand Vizier Jarasum at the Conservatory of the Arcane in Eredath.
The Unknown Reward was used as a placeholder in several test quests.
Unending Grip is a conduit for death knights. It drops from So'azmi in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market and Shriekwing in Castle Nathria.
Unleashed Frenzy is a conduit for frost death knights. It drops from Nalthor the Rimebinder in the Necrotic Wake and The Nine in the Sanctum of Domination.
Unexplainable Mystery Chicken is a chicken located at the Fizzsprings Resort in Tiragarde Sound. It has a long, white tail, which may have been the result of a gnomish invention.
The Unliving Ritual Guardian is a tol'vir ghost located in Murkdeep Cavern during the Assault in Uldum. Alongside a Ritual Guardian, he protects the Spirit of Dark Ritualist Zakahn.
Unit One-Thirty Three-Seven is a crowd pummeler piloted by a goblin that attacks Jaina Proudmoore and the Alliance champion in the Underhold during Stay of Execution (Alliance).
The Unfallen's Sanctum is a section of the House of the Chosen in Maldraxxus.
Unfallen Warhounds are helhounds located in Unfallen's Sanctum in Maldraxxus.
Undying Guardians are n'raqi located in the Crucible of Storms.
Unholy Undead is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating 9 Master Tamers in the Shadowlands with a team of all level 25 Undead pets.
__NOTOC__ The Undying Soulbinder is a Mawsworn kyrian located in the Maw.
Unleashed Tidefuries are water elementals located in Nazjatar.

Unleashed Hatred are manifestations located in Dominance Keep in Revendreth. They also appear in Sinfall when the Court of Harvesters begins a ritual to find the Medallion of Wrath. In this case, the manifestations are drawn to the Medallion of Wrath's location in Dawnkeep and will not attack.
Unfinished Granitefurs are gargon located in Dominance Keep in Revendreth.

Unleashed Rubbles are earth elementals located at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.

The Unidentified Centaur is a dead Nokhud centaur lying on the road between Szar Skeleth and Ridgewater Retreat in the Ohn'ahran Plains during Mystic Mystery. He was one of the Nokhud who ambushed Initiate Boku, and managed to grab Boku's Totem before he was killed. Interacting with the corpse causes the surviving two Nokhud Marauders to spawn and attack the player. __NOTOC__
__NOTOC__ Unleashed Storms are air revenants located in the Carving Winds in the Ohn'ahran Plains while the world quest Wind Breaker (quest) is available.

The Unique Headdress is looted from the Unidentified Tauren at by the Watering Hole of the Ohn'ahran Plains. Baine Bloodhoof is looking for it in The Search for Bovan Windtotem, part of the Old Hatreds storyline.
__NOTOC__ Unleashed Lavabursts are fire elementals located in the Life-Binder Conservatory in the Waking Shores.

Unlabeled Incense is found around Loamm in Zaralek Cavern. Interacting with it will apply one of the following smells for five minutes: *Chaotic Stench a Disoriented Endmite will follow you around. *Whimsical Whiff a Cheery Stonewhisker will follow you around.
Unlit Torches can be lit near a fire, in order to create a Burning Torch (Classic).

Unearthed Fragrant Coins come from completing public objectives in Zaralek Cavern. Spinsoa in Loamm will trade them for Whelpling's Shadowflame Crest Fragment and Drake's Shadowflame Crest Fragment, or for , which can be traded in for a companion pet and two mounts.
Unkept Aquariums are located in Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach. Nearby Escaped Fish can be tossed back in and fused into a single Unique Fish with Restorative Water.
The Unique Fish is located in Zskera Vaults in the Forbidden Reach. It is found in the Unkept Aquarium after it has been filled with Restorative Water.
Unknown Horror's Arm is sold for by Provisioner Qorra at Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus.
Unfinished Runestones are runestones located in Misty Vale in Thaldraszus.
Unliving Draenei are draenei ghosts summoned by Vengeful Draenei in the Tomb of Lights in Terokkar Forest.
The Unleashed Temporal Spark is a fire elemental located in the tower above the Everywhen Inn at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.
The Unleashed Living Ember is a fire elemental located in the tower above the forge at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.

Unliving Initiate are draenei ghosts of Slain Auchenai Warriors found at Auchindoun in Terokkar Forest. Auchenai Doomsayers send their spirits to nearby devices, managed by Auchenai Death-Speakers, reanimating their ghosts who then head further into Auchindoun. There, they are absorbed into a coffin, in a ritual overseen by additional Auchenai Death-Speakers.
United as Three is a profession achievement earned by simultaneously benefitting from the effects of the Battle Flags for Phalanx Defense, Rallying Swiftness, and Spirit of Freedom.

Unliving Summons starts the Forsaken heritage armor questline. It requires to have the Return to Lordaeron questline completed.

In World of Warcraft, Unknown may refer to: *A unit whose name has not yet been revealed. *An uncategorized creature, whose tooltip indicated "Unknown" as the creature type before Patch 4.0.1. *A race that cannot be identified
__NOTOC__ An Unstable Trigger is a component that allows a device to be activated quickly without having to worry about silly things like safety procedures.
Unstable Corpses are zombies found in the Hall of Secrets in Scholomance. Killing them results in +5 reputation with the Argent Dawn.
Unnatural Leather Spaulders are leather shoulder armor with a large amount of nature resistance.
The Unmarred Vision of Voodress is a quest reward from The Unmarred Vision of Voodress.

Unstable Affliction is an Affliction warlock talent that places a damage over time debuff on the target. If the debuff is dispelled, the dispeller will be dealt substantial damage and silenced for 4 seconds.

Unscarred Breastplate is plate chest armor sought after by Warriors, Death Knights, and Protection or Retribution Paladins. For Warriors, this is a significant upgrade to the Zandalar chest, a small upgrade the Marshal chest, and roughly similar to the Conqueror's chest.
__NOTOC__ Unstable Mana Potion is a potion that restores 1350 to 2250 mana, the same amount as a Major Mana Potion. Despite the name, it is not unstable at all.
The Unpainted Mechanostrider can be purchased for from in Dun Morogh.
Unstable Flask of the Beast can be created at the Fel Crystalforge at Forge Camp: Terror using 10 s.
Unstable Warp Rift Generator is provided as an objective for The Warp Rifts.
The Untapped Dowsing Widget was provided as an objective for Gadgetzan Water Survey. Using this item will lure out a Centipaar Tunneler.
Untested Basilisk Samples drop from the following basilisks in Tanaris: * Glasshide Gazer * Glasshide Petrifier * Glasshide Basilisk
Unstable Voidwalkers are found in southern Hellfire Peninsula.
The Unused Scraping Vial is provided as an objective for Alien Ecology. It is used to obtain a Hive Wall Sample.
The Untranslated Journal is provided as an objective for the following quests: *Translating the Journal *Translating the Journal (2)
__NOTOC__ Unseen Servants are shades found throughout Corin's Crossing in the Eastern Plaguelands. Warlocks could cast a Detect Invisibility buff on party members, removing the element of surprise.
Unprepared Sawtooth Flanks drop from Sawtooth Crocolisks and Sawtooth Snappers in the Swamp of Sorrows.
Untested Scorpid Samples dropped from the following scorpids in Tanaris: * Scorpid Duneburrower * Scorpid Hunter * Scorpid Dunestalker * Scorpid Tail Lasher
Unrefined Ore Sample drops from the following kobolds in Thousand Needles: *Gravelsnout Digger *Gravelsnout Surveyor *Gibblesnik

The Unrestrained Dragonhawk hovers on The Sin'loren in the waters north of Sun's Reach Harbor of the Isle of Quel'Danas. It offers to ferry players back to Ayren Cloudbreaker. It is involved in the following quests: *Intercept the Reinforcements† *Keeping the Enemy at Bay
Unstable Voidwraiths are voidwraiths found in the Netherstorm.
The Unsigned Field Duty Papers are provided as an objective for Field Duty (quest). Using it creates Prepared Field Duty Papers.
__NOTOC__ Unstable Mur'ghouls are mur'ghouls located at Chillmere Coast in the Howling Fjord.

Unu'pe is a small port village located at the coast of eastern Borean Tundra and has been the main tuskarr settlement in the region since the destruction of Kaskala and Pal'ea. From its port, the Kalu'ak offer free boat connections to Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.
Unrelenting Assault is a talent in the Arms tree, you will need to spend 37 points in Arms to max it.
__NOTOC__ Unsmashable Heavy Band drops from Ingvar the Plunderer in Utgarde Keep on heroic mode.
Untarnished Silver Bars can be found throughout Utgarde Pinnacle.

‎ Untalented is the term used by Blizzard for player characters who do not have any talent points in any of their talent trees. They have a 0/0/0 spec. under their talent specialization section in the Armory. All player characters are untalented by default or become untalented when they unlearn their talents at a class trainer.
Unu'pe Villagers are tuskarr villagers found in Unu'pe in the Borean Tundra.
Unu'pe Turtle Riders are tuskarr guards that patrol the village of Unu'pe in the Borean Tundra.
Unu'pe Spearman are tuskarr guards that patrol the village of Unu'pe in the Borean Tundra.

The Unsealed Chest is the quest reward from Personal Property, which begins with the Sealed Chest. The chest is dropped by the Lich King in Icecrown Citadel for wielders of Shadowmourne only.

The Unmarked Grave is located in Silverpine Forest, slightly south of Pyrewood Village at the foot of the path up to Shadowfang Keep. It is the grave of Archmage Arugal shown resurrected by the San'layn princes Keleseth, Valanar, Theraldis and Atherann in Out of Body Experience at the behest of the Lich King.
Untamed Gryphons are gryphons found in Twilight Highlands. Despite the name, hunters with the secrets of taming feathermanes can own them.
Unstable Corruptions are water elementals found in the Throne of the Tides.
Unstable Pyrelords are unbound fire elementals found in Firelands.
Unmarred Waistband is a quest reward from The Lesson of Dry Fur.
An Unruly Alemental accosts on his first visit to the (uninstanced) Stormstout Brewery, which Chen retells in Broken Dreams.

The Unscathed Egg drops from Razorgore the Untamed in Blackwing Lair.
The Untamed Ambertail is an amber scorpion located at the Chittering Coast in the Dread Wastes. It appears after the :Untamed Amber object has been interacted with.

.]] The Untamed Amber can be found lying on the ground at on the Chittering Coast of southwestern Dread Wastes. Interacting with the amber will spawn a hostile Untamed Ambertail, which will drop the Untamed Amber item when killed.

Untar Whitehorn is a tauren found in Warspear on Ashran. He is located outside Warspear Hold, next to Laesa Brightbolt.

The Unshackled are a faction of former naga slaves found in Nazjatar. An oppressed group consisting of gilgoblins, makrura, and sea giants, these refugees have banded together to rise up and seize their freedom. When Horde forces arrive in Nazjatar, they ally with the Unshackled against the naga while the Alliance befriends the Waveblade Ankoan. The first gilgoblin to escape was Neri Sharpfin, who unified the Unshackled and made a home for them. The Unshackled have a natural kinship with the species of the deep seas that have seen cruelty at the hands of the naga. Following the Nazjatar Campaign, Neri and several of her friends arrived to Durotar.
